title: A mostly great app, but could do with an update
body:
As I’ve used this app more and more, I’ve found little things here and there that could do with a change.

The list view where you can tap on the days and see a list of what’s on that day is my favourite way to look at my events, but getting from there to the other view where you can see a list of all upcoming events takes three taps!
1. Turn off List view.
2. Tap on a day to go into Day view.
3. Tap the other list button that has now appeared in the first one’s place.
It’s very unintuitive.

My second gripe is the Month view. All it has are dots to show that there’s at least one event that day, which, when you use the calendar app a lot, means there’s very few days that DONT have a dot, which makes it fairly pointless. Personally I like being able to see the events in each day (like in Google Calendar) but I can understand that, even on the biggest iPhones, that can be quite cramped and not visually appealing. However, a compromise could be to give the days multiple coloured dots to show which calendars the events come from. Personally, for example, I’m a musician, and when I have a Performance, that goes into its own special red calendar named Performances, so I could glance at the month view, see a red dot and know I have a performance on that day.

Lastly, and most concisely, the landscape “week” view only shows 5 days, not 7, which is obviously quite frustrating.

As much as I love the iOS calendar app, I’ve recently started giving Google Calendar a go, and I’m thinking I’ll stick with it until at least some of these issues are addressed. Fingers crossed :)

title: Autofill suggestions overwrite the time of your new event
body:
This is a bug and not a feature - and there seems to be no option to turn it off. 

I enter new appointments in the calendar in the following order:
1. Select date
2. Select time
3. Give appointment a title

Typing in the title field brings up a list of autofill suggestions from previous calendar events. 
For example, this might be a previous doctors appointment. 

If I select the ‘doctors appointment’ suggestion, it doesn’t just autocomplete the title and location - it changes the time I’ve entered for the new appointment to the time of the *old* appointment. 

To reiterate - the calendar automatically changes the time I’ve already selected to the WRONG time.

This is actively unhelpful. 

It’s also particularly frustrating that the calendar (famously used to keep you organised and on time) will literally *disorganise you* by changing an event to the wrong time. 

If users want to completely duplicate a previous event, this needs to be a clear and separate option.

title: Poor ability to edit notes already written in Calendar
body:
I use calendar for many many things - it’s my “go to” for reminding myself what’s on, what to pick up at the supermarket and where to go and where to meet people at my next outing and appointments. Considering the latter, I will often have to go back to the notes I have made and edit them. Herein lies the problem. 

After clicking on the edit button I can only see one line on the notes I have made. Why? Often  I can’t find the right area in which to edit my notes so I need to rewrite it because of this “one line” only being visible. This is a huge problem that has needed to be fixed for a long time. 

I also need to be very careful of the “x” at the end of the line, especially if I’m writing notes for the first time. Accidentally clicking on the x is so frustrating because I lose valuable time having to rewrite important information. 

In order to fix this problem please make the “whole” of the notes available when I click on the “edit” button so that I can edit in the appropriate area. It is so important to me and at present it is so difficult to use, hence the “two stars” rating I have given. At present, it doesn’t even deserve two stars. 

Thanks for the opportunity to be able to let you know the huge problems I have with Calendar. I hope it can be fixed very soon. 

Regards
Maryanne Anderson
